data.label: Student
data.notes: Exam peak: 3,000 concurrent users, 100 req/s (scenario traffic = high).

data.label: ACM cert (us-east-1)
data.notes: CloudFront certificates must be issued in us-east-1.

data.label: RDS PostgreSQL primary (AZ-A)
data.notes: Multi-AZ primary. publicly accessible = no. Storage encrypted with KMS.

data.label: RDS PostgreSQL standby (AZ-B)
data.notes: Multi-AZ synchronous standby; promoted to primary if AZ-A fails. publicly accessible = no.

data.label: RDS Proxy (spans data A + B)
data.notes: Proxy ENIs in both private data subnets; reads DB credentials from Secrets Manager; retargets to the new primary after Multi-AZ failover.

data.label: sg-lambda (no inbound, egress all)
data.notes: Terraform: no inbound rules, all outbound. Rules are left unset here on purpose: the lab checks Lambda invocations against the function SG, but AWS invokes Lambda through the Lambda service, not the function ENI, so inbound rules are never needed.

data.label: S3 gateway endpoint
data.notes: Gateway endpoint on app route tables A + B (no ENI).

data.label: DynamoDB gateway endpoint
data.notes: Gateway endpoint on app route tables A + B (no ENI).

data.label: Cognito User Pool
data.notes: Groups: students, tutors, admins. JWT authorizer on API Gateway.

data.label: S3 uploads (lifecycle: IA 30d > GIR 180d > DA 365d > del 1825d)
data.notes: Lifecycle: Standard-IA at 30 d, Glacier Instant Retrieval at 180 d, Deep Archive at 365 d, delete at 1,825 d.

data.label: Terraform (plan / apply)
data.notes: Stand-in node: the catalog has no Terraform service. Applies the whole stack.
